messages:
amy_sales: Kicking off Petrichor POC  quick sync. Can we confirm agenda and open blockers?

amy_sales: High-level asks from customer: evaluate extraction accuracy on internal notes, demo low-latency chat flow, and validate encryption-at-rest + VPC peering. They want a 3-week POC window.

devon_se: +1. Proposed kickoff agenda: 1) Introductions & stakeholders 2) Success criteria 3) Data access & security Qs 4) Integration plan 5) Timeline & next steps.

priya_sre: On security  they attached a 3rd-party questionnaire; flagged items: VPC peering, KMS integration, audit log retention. I can take the answers but need their network contact.

olivia_se: For success criteria we should be specific. My draft: - Extraction F1 >= 0.88 on holdout set - Chat latency P95 <= 250ms for typical 512-token context - Cost per 1k tokens under $X (TBD) - No data leaves VPC during private run. Thoughts?

amy_sales: Good. Customer care about both quality and unit economics. They asked about pilot pricing: are we offering usage pricing or a short reserved seat?

devon_se: Recommend usage-based for trial but include optional dedicated slot if they need guaranteed throughput. I'll prepare two options: pay-as-you-go estimate + 3-week reserved quote.

tim_eng: Quick note on data: if they want on-prem inference we need an SOW. For VPC peering + KMS we can do Private deployment, but timeline extends by ~2 weeks for networking approvals.

priya_sre: Action: I need network contact + SOC2/SIG docs. amy_sales can you ask Petrichor to upload the questionnaire to the shared folder and provide an IAC diagram?

amy_sales: Will request now. @Petrichor-team please share network diagram and the risk officer contact. Also confirm the 3-week window starting Apr 12.

deploy-bot: Reminder: onboarding checklist created  https://redwood.example.com/sales/petrichor/poc-checklist (private)

olivia_se: For prompts/evals  simplest approach: customer provides 200 labeled examples (gold) for extraction + 50 live examples for chat eval. We'll run our eval harness and return aggregated metrics. Ask them to mark high-priority entities.

devon_se: Example eval prompt (share with customer):
```
System: You are an assistant that extracts medication, dosage, and frequency from clinical notes.
User: "Patient was started on lisinopril 10mg once daily for BP control."
Expected: {medication: "lisinopril", dosage: "10mg", frequency: "once daily"}
```

amy_sales: Customer asked about data retention during the POC. Priya  what's our default?

priya_sre: For hosted trials we keep logs 30 days by default; for Private we can set retention per contract. We'll note retention in the DPA appendix.

tim_eng: Integration items: SDK keys, sample ingestion script, and an ingest pipeline for streaming notes. Devon can we surface a minimal python snippet?

devon_se: Sure  will post sample in the repo. Minimal snippet:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="REDACTED")
resp = client.extract(text="...", model="redwood-extract-v1")
print(resp)
```

olivia_se: Success criteria checklist for kickoff (to confirm with Petrichor):
- Provide 200 labeled extraction examples by Day 3
- Shared network diagram & SOC2 docs Day 2
- Baseline eval (ours) within 5 working days of data ingest
- Integration demo by end of week 2
- Decision checkpoint end of week 3 (go/no-go)

amy_sales: Customer stakeholder map we have so far: CTO (decision), Dir. ML Ops (technical owner), Security lead (approvals). I'll add names when they reply.

devon_se: Potential blocker: If they require HSM-backed keys for KMS we need procurement lead  Priya, can you check HSM partner options and timeline?

priya_sre: On it  will check HSM compatibility and whether we can map to customer KMS.

amy_sales: Next steps: I'll ask Petrichor for confirmation of the dates, upload the questionnaire, and provide stakeholder contacts. Devon  can you prepare two pricing templates (usage + 3-week reserved) by EOD tomorrow? Olivia  finalize success criteria doc and sample prompts. Priya & Tim  flag infra blockers and estimated network lead time.

olivia_se: I'll also put together an eval rubric (precision/recall, latency, and cost delta) and share a short results dashboard sample.

devon_se: Will do. Also: quick kludge for low-latency test  we'll run a 10k-request synthetic load to measure P95. Need agreement they can accept synthetic traffic hitting staging.

amy_sales: Good call  I'll ask. Anything else?

tim_eng: Nothing from infra besides network contact.

priya_sre: If they want encrypted logging, we should confirm key rotation policy. Add to questionnaire.

amy_sales: Perfect. I'll follow up after I hear back from their security lead. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
